checks.text: The page displays the heading "Packing List" and, with no items, the text "No items yet".
Typing "Passport" in the field labelled "Item name" and clicking the button "Add item" adds a list item containing "Passport" with an unchecked checkbox; the text "No items yet" is removed.
After adding "Passport" and "Toothbrush", clicking the checkbox on the "Passport" item changes its status to checked and the progress indicator shows "1 of 2 packed".
Clicking the button "Edit" on the "Toothbrush" item opens an inline edit field; typing "Toothpaste" and pressing Enter changes the item label to "Toothpaste".
With items "Passport" (checked) and "Toothpaste" (unchecked), clicking the button "Copy summary" copies the text "Packed: Passport\nRemaining: Toothpaste" to the clipboard.

Clicking the tab "Trip details" shows a form with fields labelled "Destination" and "Departure date"; typing "Paris" in "Destination" and "2025-06-15" in "Departure date" and clicking "Save" persists these values, visible when returning to the "Items" tab.
With items "Passport" and "Toothpaste", pressing the keyboard shortcut Alt+ArrowUp on the "Toothpaste" item moves it above "Passport", so the first list item is "Toothpaste".
Clicking the button "Delete" on the "Toothpaste" item removes it from the list; the progress indicator shows "1 of 1 packed" and only "Passport" remains.
Reload keeps the item "Passport" in the checked state and the trip details "Paris" and "2025-06-15" after navigating away and back.
